label: Week of 19 November
notes: Shopping Thursday 19 November; the week runs Thursday to Wednesday. Five dinners, Thursday to Monday, and five weekday lunches.
Thursday is the spring rolls you asked for, with carrot, lettuce and a peanut dipping sauce. Friday is sushi: smoked salmon, avocado and cucumber maki.
Saturday is stuffed peppers, Sunday a coconut chicken curry, Monday gnocchi with pesto rosso. Three Asian dinners, two European. Proteins: chicken twice, salmon, beef, and a vegetarian Monday.
Saturday's peppers and Sunday's curry both make four portions, so Monday's and Tuesday's lunches come out of them.
The last receipt is from 29 September, so nothing is assumed to be in the kitchen. Strike off anything you already have.

meals.note: Make the peanut sauce first; it loosens as it sits.
Keep a cup of the sushi rice back if you like: it is Wednesday's onigiri.
